notes: No kb/Work note owns the fix. §1985:VI.5.14.3 SR6: "The BLANK WHEN ZERO, JUSTIFIED, PICTURE, SYNCHRONIZED, and VALUE clauses must not be specified for data items whose usage is INDEX." Four of the five clauses are refused at every edition, 85 included, for a usage the entry writes and for one a group hands down (§1985:VI.5.14.4 GR1): PICTURE by BindEntry and UsageInheritanceElementary through Sr8PicturelessVerdict (COBOL0881), VALUE by the same two members over AdmitsNoValueLiteral (COBOL2168, a group entry with USAGE INDEX and VALUE included), BLANK WHEN ZERO and JUSTIFIED by CheckClauseSubjectsPass.Run over BlankWhenZeroViolation and JustifiedViolation (COBOL2405). SYNCHRONIZED is not implemented for 85: the only screen on the clause is the group gate, and InheritSynchronized passes an elementary item of any usage, which is the 2023 rule (§2023:13.18.55.3 SR1 excludes no usage). Probed at --std 85: 01 I USAGE INDEX with BLANK WHEN ZERO, JUSTIFIED RIGHT, JUST, PIC 9(4), PIC X(4), VALUE 1 and VALUE ZERO is refused, and so is each clause on an elementary item under 01 G USAGE INDEX; 01 I4 USAGE IS INDEX SYNCHRONIZED, 01 I7 INDEX SYNC RIGHT and 05 J4 SYNC LEFT under a USAGE INDEX group compile clean and the items work in SET. The witness is 01 IX PICTURE 9 USAGE IS INDEX, refused with COBOL0881.

next.reason: 1985 refuses BLANK WHEN ZERO, JUSTIFIED, PICTURE, SYNCHRONIZED and VALUE on a USAGE INDEX item. 2023 still refuses four of the five: §2023:13.16.3 SR8 (no PICTURE for an item whose usage is index), §2023:13.16.3 SR10 ('The VALUE clause shall not be specified for data items of class index'), §2023:13.18.8.3 SR1 and SR2 (BLANK WHEN ZERO only for numeric or numeric-edited items of usage display or national), and §2023:13.18.32.3 SR3 (JUSTIFIED only for categories alphabetic, alphanumeric, boolean or national, while §2023:13.18.60.4 GR10 makes an index item's category index). SYNCHRONIZED is no longer refused: §2023:13.18.55.3 SR1 'The SYNCHRONIZED clause may be specified for group and elementary items', and no 2023 rule excludes index items. A refused program (SYNC on an index item) is now accepted.
